items.source: since 4.0: callers must specify a concrete trim strategy (MAXLEN or MINID) via RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions; do not use this method to only toggle approximate/exact. Prefer XAddOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(n).approximate()) or XAddOptions.trim(TrimOptions.minId(id).exact()).
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起：调用者必须通过RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions指定具体的修剪策略（MAXLEN 或 MINID）；请勿使用此方法仅用于切换近似/精确模式。 建议使用XAddOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(n).approximate())或 XAddOptions.trim(TrimOptions.minId(id).exact())。

items.source: since 4.0: callers must specify a concrete trim strategy (MAXLEN or MINID) via RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions; do not use this method to only toggle approximate/exact.

items.source: Apply efficient trimming for capped streams using the ~ flag.
items.translation: 使用 `~` 标志对封顶流应用高效的修剪。
